summary: Ubuntu 10.04 (Lucid Lynx) was the third LTS release. Desktop support ended 9 May 2013; server 9 May 2015. It introduced a new light theme (Ambiance and Radiance), Me Menu for social/status, PiTiVi video editor, and a purple theme that persisted for many years. Included Shotwell photo manager and a simplified software center. Focus on visual refresh while preserving usability.
notes: Desktop EOL 2013-05-09; server EOL 2015-05-09. Kernel 2.6.32. Lucid marked a shift toward a more polished, consistent look that became Ubuntu's signature.
